title: Gate decoding
statement: For a natural number $S$, a gate code consists of a kind code in $	ext{Fin}(3)$ and two optional argument indices in $	ext{Fin}(S)$. Decode the kind code as conjunction, disjunction, or negation according as it is $0$, $1$, or $2$, and form the gate's argument list by taking the values of the two present indices in order, omitting absent ones.
